userQuote: I approve the latest reviewed standing and running sprites, including the corrected frame placement. Their artwork, facial detail, proportions, movement weight, and animation style are now GOD MODE’s production standard.
scope: 24 standing references and six displayed running sequences, current image plus corrected placement revisions. Approval does not extend to unseen direction animation or integration.
